paragraphs: I am an architecture graduate working in architecture field with particular interest in project delivery process. My current professional interests is about information management and design delivery, particularly ISO 19650, information management, multidisciplinary coordination, workflows, and BIM processes. I also explore building performance simulation, including thermal, solar, microclimate analysis, and daylight analysis to support my work.
Beyond buildings, my interest extend to placemaking and built environment development strategy, encompassing planning, community engagement, feasibility studies, and development potential assessment.

experience.description: Working on digital processes, information structures, coordination methods, and tools that support architectural project delivery.

experience.organization: PENTA Architecture | Rumah Dinas Bank Indonesia Slipi, Jakarta
Tools: Autodesk Forma CDE Management, Autodesk Forma Design Coordination, Autodesk Naviswork Manage, Microsoft Projects
Skills: Clash Detection, 4D Scheduling, Revit Modelling, Multidisciplinary Coordination

experience.description: Worked on technical proposals and preliminary architectural design for public-sector projects, including office buildings, hospitals, airports, public facilities, and mixed-use developments.
items: Developed and adapted preliminary designs in response to technical, site, and functional requirements.
Coordinated architectural design with Structure, MEP, Geotechnical, Infrastructure, Landscape, and Interior disciplines.
Collaborated with drafting teams to develop architectural working drawings and proposal documentation.
Produced architectural drawings, diagrams, and visual materials using Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Photoshop, and PowerPoint.
Worked within Revit-based collaborative environments through Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
Used Rhino and Grasshopper for selected form-development and façade studies.

highlights.label: Selected Project Highlight
highlights.title: Airfield Planning
highlights.description: Contributed as an architectural assistant to Soewondo Airfield planning, covering terminal and hangar facilities, airside planning including runway, taxiway, apron, and aircraft movement, as well as operational and supporting facilities.

highlights.title: Airport Planning
highlights.description: Contributed to preliminary airport planning, including basic passenger-flow strategies and early Level of Service considerations.

highlights.title: Healthcare Facility Planning
highlights.organization: RS Jantung & Pembuluh Darah Harapan Kita · 2023, RS Tarempa · 2024, RS Adhyaksa Jambi · 2024, RS Adhyaksa Ceger - 2026
highlights.description: Contributed to preliminary design and layout development for healthcare facilities, with exposure to hospital circulation, functional relationships, and healthcare-specific spatial requirements.

highlights.title: Topography-Responsive Site Planning
highlights.organization: Basilika & Gereja IKN Proposal · 2024, RTH Orchid IKN · 2025, Gedung DPR 2 IKN - 2025
highlights.description: Reviewed and adjusted building and road placement in response to existing topography, exploring strategies to reduce cut-and-fill and respond more closely to site conditions.

highlights.title: Indoor Sports Facility Proposal
highlights.description: Developed preliminary design for an indoor sports facility for Paralympic athletes, including programming, spatial layout, accessibility considerations, and early design concept development.

experience.description: In-house architectural intern at a real estate development firm, assisting with house renovations, supervising construction activities, and evaluating completed work.
Skills: Architectural and landscape design, communication, problem-solving, interdisciplinary collaboration, and real estate management.

experience.organization: Sekola Boto - Ikatan Arsitek Indonesia Jawa Timur
experience.description: Guided a workshop as a co-mentor exploring innovative modular brick shape and its applications. Acquired hands-on experience in brick production, construction techniques, and brick arrangements.
Skills: Team leadership, public speaking, creativity, problem solving

highlights.title: Placemaking
highlights.organization: Bandung Institute of Technology × University of Melbourne
highlights.description: Designed a mixed-use building and public space for low-income residents in Kampung Pesanggrahan, Jakarta. Conducted site and stakeholder analysis through observation, interviews, community engagement, and social experiments to identify social and environmental issues. Developed a participatory facility program intended to enable residents to build, manage, and further develop the space collectively.

highlights.title: Algorithmic Design & Bamboo in Architecture
highlights.organization: Bandung Institute of Technology × AA School of Architecture
highlights.description: Developed an environmentally adaptable housing proposal for communities in Haiti by analyzing site conditions and evaluating existing housing through environmental simulations. Explored bamboo construction and algorithmic modelling to develop façade and roof systems aimed at improving climate responsiveness and living conditions.

highlights.title: Collaborative Interdisciplinary Discipline Project (CIDP)
highlights.description: Worked with civil, mechanical, and electrical engineering students to analyze an existing building, its site, and user behavior. Modelled and redesigned the building in Revit using linked multidisciplinary models, explored natural lighting and ventilation strategies, developed custom Revit families, and produced the final design proposal.
